== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Blood Shadows are spiritual parasites originating from the [[Dreadgod]] known as the [[Bleeding Phoenix]]. They function primarily as [[hunger spirits]] designed to drain power from hosts and return that essence to The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix. While they often seek out hosts to consume them, some individuals can establish a symbiotic relationship with a [[Shadow]] through immense [[willpower]]. These entities are highly mutable and can be developed into different forms depending on how they are fed. There are several recognized classifications of Blood Shadows. The most basic is the formless [[Shadow]], which is fed primarily with [[blood madra]] and functions as a controllable weapon or tool. A more advanced version is the bestial [[Shadow]], which is fed actual [[blood]] to take on monstrous or beast-like shapes. The most perfected form is a true copy of the host, acting as a loyal partner that shares the user's thoughts and abilities, effectively serving as an additional combatant. In addition to these controlled forms, Blood Shadows can manifest as mindless or monstrous entities. They are capable of producing Bloodspawn{{!}}bloodspawn—faceless, shambling creatures that can [[sacrifice]] themselves to attack enemies or strangle targets using crimson vines. While some users, such as those in [[Redmoon Hall]], allow their Shadows to take control, masters of the [[technique]] use them as extensions of their own [[sacred arts]].}}
